end.summary: Practised identifying quadrants using the signs of x and y.
end.parentNote: Asha practised reading and plotting ordered pairs, including (–2, 4), and used horizontal-then-vertical movement to explain coordinates. Harsh correctly identified the second quadrant and the origin in several responses. They mixed up (3, 2) and (2, 3); later they described the different movements, but the mix-up was still noted. At home, practise plotting a few pairs by saying “first x, then y” and checking whether reversing them changes the point.
